issue.title: Bob Mac Capture copy for project pull-in (trigger: project_empty) rows

task_type_fields.proposal: Bob Mac Capture should render bob capture `unblocked[]` / `still_blocked[]` rows whose `trigger` is `project_empty` with their own copy instead of as ordinary linked successors: in the live preview and in the post-submit notification line, a linked pull-in reads like `🔓 Next in FIX: Ship the outcome! · project has no open tasks`, a surfaced row (`link: null`, status unchanged, `hide_removed: true`) reads `🔓 Surfaced: Ship the outcome! (Ready) · project has no open tasks`, and still-blocked project rows add `· no open tasks` (docs/task-dependencies.md §12.10 Reporting → Notice text, which already names the Mac notification line). The JSON is additive and already shipped by bob-cli-74 (bob-cli 309e98a: `trigger`, `hide_removed`). Root cause: the Mac app ignores `trigger` and so pull-in rows render as plain linked successors (by design for bob-cli-74).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Proposed by bob-cli-74.6 note #2. bob-cli-74's plan listed Bob Mac Capture code as out of scope (the JSON change is additive and pull-in rows render acceptably as linked successors), so the distinct copy is a separate Swift change in the bob-mac-capture repo.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-74.6 proposed it: bob capture now reports project pull-ins with trigger project_empty, but the Mac app renders them as ordinary linked successors.

payload.description: 73 is another Bob Mac Capture rendering change for bob capture project-blocking results
